         1. such that a rep/cov conditions is not capable of being satisfied

items.point: Parent may terminate for a continuing representation or covenant breach that prevents satisfaction of the relevant condition, after written notice, if uncured or incapable of cure by the earlier of 30 days after notice and the outside date, subject to the reciprocal Parent-breach bar.
